messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: From today the pager for the event-bus rings the Boreal team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-02-13] standup/boreal/2025-02-13: The notifier calls the event-bus for delivery events, so treat the event-bus as a hard dependency of the notifier. Dependency map update: webhooks needs the event-bus (outbound events).
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: The event bus is a the Boreal team service. The Boreal team owns notifier.
- [2025-09-09] handover/2025-09-09-event-bus: Boreal handed the bus to the Dune team today; Marcus Oyelaran wrote up the handover doc for Tomasz Nowak.
- [2026-05-05] standup/boreal/2026-05-05: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17-2: Reminder: the event-bus deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2025-04-22] standup/boreal/2025-04-22: Per the change policy, the event-bus deploys on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2025-11-11] standup/boreal/2025-11-11-2: Heads-up from team Boreal: the event bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-09-19] standup/boreal/2025-09-19: We decided that reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly. The reason: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. That removes the dependency on Ledger from the reporting service.
- [2025-11-13] standup/boreal/2025-11-13: The reporting service still relies on the bus; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: Team Ember owns the job scheduler.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, Ledger is owned by team Atlas.
- [2025-12-08] standup/dune/2025-12-08-2: Heads-up from team Dune: the bus' request volume halved after the client rollout.
- [2025-05-15] standup/dune/2025-05-15-2: Reminder: the job scheduler is owned by Dune.
- [2025-04-10] standup/ember/2025-04-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: Team Dune owns the reporting service.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20: For the record, image-resizer is owned by team Dune.
- [2025-09-15] standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2: Team Boreal still owns search-indexer, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team. Cinder owns the indexer.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: Atlas owns billing-api. Atlas looks after the flags service.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-reporting: Ownership change: the reports pipeline now sits with team Ember. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-02-11] incident-review/INC-2026-003: Incident review INC-2026-003. The webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-08. Root cause: a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. Decision: webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-12-15] standup/cinder/2025-12-15: Team change: Diego leaves team Cinder and joins team Ember, effective today. With Diego moving on, Yuki is on call for the Cinder team from today.
- [2025-11-19] handover/2025-11-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-webhooks: The webhook dispatcher has a new home: Dune. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-09-24] standup/boreal/2025-09-24: Marcus picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena today.
- [2025-07-21] standup/atlas/2025-07-21: As of today Tomasz is on Dune; Atlas loses a pair of hands.
- [2025-05-21] standup/boreal/2025-05-21: Lena picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Marcus today.
- [2025-05-02] standup/cinder/2025-05-02: Yuki picked up the Cinder on-call shift from Diego today.
- [2026-06-17] standup/ember/2026-06-17: Oskar picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego Alvarez today.
- [2026-04-14] standup/atlas/2026-04-14: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Atlas on-call shift from Priya today.
